If true, this action from the U.S. Supreme Court would be devastating for women and families across the country. Thankfully, here in Colorado, our elected officials are prioritizing women’s healthcare and reproductive rights.

We're at a turning point in the fight for reproductive rights. We can't let @SenateGOP block this fundamental freedom of women.

That’s why I signed a letter with 100+ members of Congress to urge the Senate to #EndtheFilibuster so we can pass the Women’s Health Protection Act. https://t.co/jjxpT20sB9

Today the Senate will vote on the #WomensHealthProtectionAct to enshrine Roe v. Wade into law and ensure a woman's health care decisions remain between her, her family & her doctor. 

If today's vote fails, we must #EndTheFilibuster to preserve this fundamental right.

1/ Today’s ruling formalizes a decades-long attempt to take away a women’s constitutional right to choose and the freedom to do what is best for her and her family. Women’s healthcare decisions are between her and her doctor.

2/ I applaud the action of Colorado and other states to prioritize women’s healthcare and uphold women’s reproductive freedoms. However, by dismantling these federal protections, a patchwork of disparate state laws will emerge and women across the country...

3/ will be left with uneven, unjust & dangerous options for their reproductive healthcare needs. For too many women across this country, today is a dark day & marks the loss of a basic right & a freedom to make their own healthcare decisions & control their future. #RoeVsWade

I'm glad Colorado will continue to prioritize women’s healthcare & uphold their reproductive freedoms.
